title: [master][Subscription Billing] 1M 'Align to End of Month' line with end date produces a 1-day prorated stub
summary: Fixed a bug in Subscription Billing where monthly billing with Align to End of Month created an unwanted one-day prorated line when the subscription ended. The period end date calculation now properly includes the subscription line end date.
key_points: Monthly billing cycles with Align to End of Month no longer create spurious one-day prorated billing lines at the subscription end date
CalculateNextToDate now caps the calculated period end date at the subscription line end date when applicable
End-date handling improved to include the subscription line end date in the current billing period
Fixes vendor contracts that were incorrectly generating extra billing lines
quote: The billing period ended one day before the Subscription Line End Date, creating an unintended one-day prorated billing line.
